messages:
kelly: Heads-up — we need to run the quarterly least-priv review for admin/service roles next week. Planning window: Wed 09:00-13:00 PT. Can folks confirm owners for KMS-admin bindings and any known exceptions? :eyes:

ashwin: I can take KMS on the infra side. Quick q: do we consider cross-account grants as 'exception' or do we treat them as separate tickets to remediate?

maria: Treat cross-account as exceptions but we should create a remediation ticket per grant. We need owner evidence for each to keep in the audit package.

kelly: Agreed. Owner evidence = Slack or GH PR + short justification. We'll attach to the recert CSV.

josh: FYI I ran a quick query against our audit logs for suspicious KMS admin actions — found 2 late-night grant calls from svc-datalab-prod that look legit but missing owner tag. Posting snippet:

```
# BigQuery query (simplified)
SELECT principal, resource, proto_payload.methodName, timestamp
FROM `company-audit.kms.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity`
WHERE proto_payload.methodName LIKE '%SetIamPolicy%'
AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

josh: I'll open tickets for the two entries and ping the service owners.

ashwin: For remediation, propose: 1) owner proof attached, 2) either move binding to short-lived grant or add justification + rotation schedule, 3) mark for re-review in 30 days. Thoughts? :+1:

maria: Solid. Also check for hard-coded KMS keys in infra repos. I can run a repo scan and flag findings to the ticket.

kelly: Good call. @audit-bot can you export current entitlement CSV (RBAC + KMS) and drop in the shared drive for triage?

audit-bot: Export started: generating entitlement CSV (rbac_kms_snapshot_3691012345.csv). ETA ~3m.

oncall: Quick reminder — if any remediation involves key rotation during the window, coordinate with oncall and post rollback steps in the ticket. We had a partial outage last year when rotation happened without the fallback plan.

kelly: Noted. No planned rotations during the main window unless explicitly approved. Any volunteers to lead the admin-prune canary? Need someone to run the small pilot on staging and monitor logs/latency.

ashwin: I’ll run the canary on staging Thursday 10am PT and report rollout metrics.

josh: I’ll help monitor and collect perf traces; will add alert rules to the ticket (lambda for alert on 5xx and token errors).

maria: I'll curate the owner evidence template and the CSV column schema we want (principal, binding_type, resource, owner, evidence_link, justification, remediation_plan). Will drop template: https://drive.company/reports/least-priv/templates

kelly: Perfect. Action items: 1) ashwin -> staging canary (Thu 10am) 2) josh -> open tickets for 2 KMS entries + add alerts 3) maria -> repo scan + evidence template 4) audit-bot -> entitlement CSV export (done) 5) all -> owners add evidence by EOD Mon.

ashwin: noted, adding to my calendar.

josh: tickets created: #SEC-8341, #SEC-8342. Pinging owners now.

audit-bot: Entitlement CSV uploaded: https://drive.company/sec/entitlements/rbac_kms_snapshot_3691012345.csv

kelly: Thanks everyone. We’ll sync Mon 11am PT for triage. If you see anything high-risk before then, escalate to #incidents. :lock:

maria: Thanks — will post repo scan summary before Mon sync.

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll standby for any rotation approvals.

kelly: Closing thread for now — will reopen with triage notes on Monday.
